summary.text: Taiwan held local elections on Saturday for mayors and other local leaders. Kuomintang mayor Chiang Wan-an was re-elected in Taipei after a close race against the ruling DPP's Puma Shen, a China critic. The KMT also held New Taipei and won Quemoy, but lost Taichung, Changhua, Yilan and Hsinchu county, while the DPP kept Kaohsiung.

conclusion.text: All coverage agrees Chiang Wan-an was re-elected in Taipei after a close race against China critic Puma Shen. No contradictions appear.
